_doc: Single source of truth for every backend URL/path the edge-proxy worker (or its companion deploy infra)
hard-codes outside the FastAPI app. Task #887 — added so the Task #877 class of bug (a probe URL drifts
away from the real router prefix and silently 404s for ~56h before anyone notices) can be caught by a
deterministic CI check instead of a manual log review.
Task #900 extended the manifest to also cover the edge-cache config (CACHEABLE_PREFIXES / CACHE_TTL /
BYPASS_PREFIXES / USER_SPECIFIC_PREFIXES) — same drift class: a renamed FastAPI route silently stops
matching the cache rule and bypasses the cache forever, with no probe ever firing. Cache-related
entries carry an optional `edge_cache` block; `workers/edge-proxy/src/index.ts` derives its runtime
constants from this manifest via `monitored-urls.ts` so there is exactly one source of truth.
Task #901 added a second drift gate: each `registered_in` file must actually still mention the path,
either as a literal string or via a declared `runtime_constant` export name. This catches the case
where a registered file is refactored to no longer reference the path (or the path constant is renamed)
but the manifest entry rots silently.
Two arrays:
backend_paths       — paths that MUST resolve to a real FastAPI route (exact-match on the OpenAPI
schema, or prefix-match when 'match' is 'prefix'). Add a one-line 'rationale'
so a future reader knows why the worker hard-codes the path.
intentionally_external — full URLs the worker hits that are NOT FastAPI routes (e.g. the public
homepage served by Cloudflare Pages, an external webhook endpoint). Each entry
MUST carry a non-empty 'rationale' or the drift test fails.
Task #916 added an HTTP-method gate: backend_paths entries can declare a `method` (defaults to
'GET'). The drift test asserts the live OpenAPI path item actually exposes that verb — catching the
Task #877 sibling failure mode where a probe GETs a POST-only endpoint and 405s forever. For
match='exact' entries the method must be exposed by that exact path; for match='prefix' entries at
least one path under the prefix must expose the method (the prefix is a route family, not a single
endpoint, so a strict per-path check would be meaningless).
Optional fields on backend_paths / intentionally_external entries:
method                  — uppercase HTTP verb the worker actually sends (GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE).
Defaults to 'GET'. Annotate any entry whose worker-side caller is NOT a
GET — e.g. webhooks (POST), AI streaming chat (POST) — so the Task #916
method-drift gate can verify the live route actually accepts that verb.
edge_cache.behavior     — 'cacheable' (worker stores in CF cache) or 'bypass' (worker forbids caching).
edge_cache.ttl_seconds  — cache TTL when behavior='cacheable'. Required for cacheable entries.
edge_cache.user_keyed   — when true, the cache key includes a per-user identity header so each user
gets their own cached entry (e.g. /api/user/stats).
edge_cache.cache_hit_ratio_target — Task #571 advisory floor: the per-route hit-ratio CF Analytics
should report under steady state. Not enforced by code (the edge worker has
no read-back path for CF cache stats); the admin /api/health/cache panel
renders this alongside the live AI-cache numbers so the runbook knows when
to escalate. Defaults derived from (TTL, traffic shape) per `target_for()`
in the Task #571 jq patch.
edge_cache.exam_ttl_seconds — Task #575 optional stretched TTL applied while the backend's
cache_calendar.current_season() is 'exam' or 'results'. The worker polls
/api/health/season (60 s in-DO cache) and uses this value in place of
ttl_seconds during AHSEC/SEBA exam + results windows. Routes without it
keep ttl_seconds unchanged regardless of season — opting out is just
'leave the field off'. Founder locks (/api/me/quota 5s, /api/ai/chat
bypass, $100/mo cap, TOKEN_BUDGETS) are explicitly NOT touched by this knob.
runtime_constant        — name of the exported identifier (constant or helper function) that the
registered_in file uses to reach this path/URL. When set, the Task #901
drift test accepts the file mentioning that identifier as a stand-in for
the literal path string (use this for paths the file consumes via an
import rather than inlining as a literal).
smoke_skip_reason       — Task #917 — when present, the in-process probe-smoke test (which boots
the FastAPI app under TestClient and asserts every backend_paths entry
returns < 500) skips this entry, with the reason surfaced in pytest -v
output. Use this ONLY when the 5xx is a known test-stub artifact (e.g.
the handler awaits a motor cursor pattern that tests/_deps_stub.py does
not yet model) — never to paper over a real production 5xx.
If you add a new probe / healthcheck / hard-coded backend URL anywhere, register it here. The drift
test (artifacts/syrabit-backend/tests/test_monitoring_url_drift.py) gates merges on this manifest.

backend_paths.smoke_skip_reason: Task #917 — handler in seo_engine.py uses the motor cursor pattern `await db.seo_pages.find(...).to_list(50000)` which tests/_deps_stub.py does not yet model (the stub returns an AsyncMock for `find_one` but a plain MagicMock for `find`, so `find(...).to_list` is non-awaitable). Real production has motor + Mongo so this is not a runtime bug; remove this annotation once _deps_stub gains cursor support.
